title: Stained Glass Selfie
description: A young woman in a jeweled bikini and flowing purple headscarf takes a selfie with a smartphone while standing in a lavender field. Behind her is an elaborate colorful stained glass window depicting armored elephants and mice in a fantasy procession under a golden sun.
